\### 👨‍💻 About



I'm a motivated and detail-oriented cybersecurity student pursuing a \*\*Bachelor of Computer Science (Cyber Security)\*\* at the University of Wollongong. 



I have hands-on experience from IT support internships, where I learned that the most interesting parts of tech are often the unglamorous ones: resolving endpoint issues, managing networks, and dealing with the reality of weekly tickets. I apply critical thinking and problem-solving strategies to complex technical challenges, whether it's securing a system or debugging a client's Windows environment.



Working hours are \*\*UTC+8\*\* (Singapore), which means I'm usually online when the rest of the tech world is heading to bed.



\---



\### ⚙️ Currently working on



\- \*\*Cybersecurity Foundations.\*\* Deep diving into network security, threat modeling, and secure configurations as part of my university coursework.

\- \*\*Practical IT \& Infrastructure.\*\* Building on my internship experience with Windows OS, hardware troubleshooting, and network endpoints.

\- \*\*Automation \& Scripting.\*\* Applying critical thinking to automate mundane tasks and improve system reliability.
